kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai sets, Kyoto-vegetable courses, nama-fu dengaku, agedashi tofu, tempura, kamameshi and shabu-shabu; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.vegan_detail: Ask. Many Kyoto-vegetable and tofu dishes, but dashi is not described (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:15; last entry 22:00) daily (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog; 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 105 seats over two floors, with private rooms for 6 to 30 and a counter (Tabelog; August 2026). In a machiya on Pontocho south of Sanjo, about 5 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_suishin_honten.notes: [Obanzai and kaiseki · Pontocho machiya, Kyoto vegetables] A big, calm two-storey machiya on Pontocho with a counter and private rooms, serving obanzai sets, nama-fu dengaku and kamameshi à la carte, and Kyoto-vegetable courses from ¥4,950 — seasonal touches like matsutake-and-hamo dobin-mushi in autumn. Good for families and celebrations.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T8130001022725 is registered to 株式会社黛 of Kyoto (NTA register). Our crawl also lists 京すいしん and 炭火焼酒房 すいしん; how many shops the company runs was not established. Reviewers praise attentive staff who explain the ingredients (August and October 2026).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family shared a laugh with the staff over what obanzai means, then shared a five-dish set and kamameshi.
An October 2026 trio of mother, brother and diner, rarely drinkers, ended up ordering drinks over matsutake kamameshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町すいしん 本店、日本料理・海鮮・居酒屋、中京区先斗町三条下ル材木町181、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、毎日17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:15、最終入店22:00)、カード可、105席、6〜30名の個室、京町家、京野菜とおばんざい、京の味覚コース「嵐山」4,950円、会席「桃山」5,500円から、適格請求書 T8130001022725 (株式会社黛)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 「加茂」コース (松茸と鱧の土瓶蒸し、子持ち鮎の塩焼き、蕪と鮎の湯葉あん)、おばんざい5種盛り、揚げ出し豆腐、茄子や生麩の田楽、とうもろこしの天ぷら、松茸の釜飯、だし巻き、京都ポークと野菜のしゃぶしゃぶ、湯葉とトマトのゼリー、カウンターの実演、京都の地酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Large machiya with private rooms; staff explain dishes.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_plum.gf_detail: Ask. French-based teppan and à la carte — steaks, abalone steak with bread, gratins, onion gratin soup, tempura of mino, pilaf; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_plum.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Wagyu, abalone, oysters, tongue and offal (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_plum.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday and holidays 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス料10%). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter on the left and two tables for four (Tabelog; February 2026). Now at street level on Gion-machi Kitagawa after a move (September 2026), about 5 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_plum.notes: [Teppan bistro · Gion Kitagawa, abalone and Wagyu] A small machiya counter and two tables in Gion where chefs cook French-leaning dishes on the teppan in front of you — a much-loved abalone steak, filet and tongue, oyster gratins, onion soup and a garlic pilaf — à la carte. 10% service charge; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes skilled chefs cooking Wagyu and abalone steaks before guests in a machiya, with French-based creative dishes of Kyoto ingredients. A September 2026 regular notes the restaurant has moved to a street-level site.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 visitor who comes to Kyoto once a year was thrilled by fried fish as the first nibble and finished with the special pilaf.
An October 2025 regular back after a long gap found the place packed, but missed the matsutake that year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 ぷらむ、鉄板焼き・ビストロ、東山区祇園町北側259-1、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土・祝 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、日曜定休、サービス料10%、カード可、20席、町家、京都の食材のフレンチがベースの創作料理、目の前で焼く和牛や鮑のステーキ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 鮑のステーキとパン、フィレステーキ、牛のたたき、オニオングラタンスープ、牡蠣のグラタン、ガーリックライス、ミノの天ぷら、焼き牡蠣、牛タンの焼き物とシチュー、特製ピラフ、蟹酢、人数に合わせた刺身とサラダ、移転して1階の店に。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_sushi_kita_no_sachi.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase of sushi and Hokkaido seafood — hairy crab, scallops, herring-roe rolls; soy sauce not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_kita_no_sachi.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–2:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). No menu — the chef’s omakase (March 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Gion-machi Kitagawa, about 240 m from Gion-Shijo Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_kita_no_sachi.notes: [Sushi · Gion Kitagawa, Hokkaido seafood late] A Gion sushi counter serving Hokkaido and northern fish as omakase — hairy crab, scallops, a herring-roe roll — from a kind chef who explains each piece, open until 2:00. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer describes a kind chef who explains each dish and ingredients mostly from Hokkaido and the north; a September 2025 regular calls it a usual haunt.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor, on a second stop, was surprised to find Hokkaido flavours in Kyoto and took the chef’s omakase.
Another March 2026 diner singled out a herring-roe sushi roll as something found only here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: すし処 北の幸、寿司、東山区祇園町北側256、祇園四条駅から241m、月〜土 18:00〜翌2:00、日曜定休、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 北海道や北の産地の魚介、品書きのないおまかせ、旬の毛蟹、ほたて、数の子の巻物、説明してくれる優しい大将、2〜3万円ほど。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_nagisa_club.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar — fruit cocktails and a few sweets; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagisa_club.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh-fruit cocktails, some with yogurt (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nagisa_club.hours_raw: Monday and Wednesday–Sunday 18:00–3:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Charge ¥300 (Tabelog, original チャージ300円). Cards including UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 28 seats with tables (Tabelog; January 2026). In the basement of the World Kaikan, just west of where the 南大黒橋通 lane leaves Kiyamachi, 5 min from Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; May 2026). Founded in 1956 (May 2026 review).
kyoto_nagisa_club.notes: [Cocktail bar · off Kiyamachi, since 1956] A surprisingly calm, retro basement bar off Kiyamachi, said to date from 1956, mixing fresh-fruit cocktails — gin and tonic, raspberry yogurt, salty dog, espresso martini — and alcohol-free versions, with fresh chocolate. ¥300 charge; open until 3:00; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer calls it an authentic bar in business since 1956; a January 2026 visitor was greeted by a polite, gentle bartender.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 group of four, unsure of space, found a table free and had a non-alcoholic kiwi frozen-yogurt cocktail.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ナギサ クラブ、バー、中京区河原町三条二筋下がる東入ル大黒町71 ワールド会館B1、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、月・水〜日 18:00〜翌3:00、火曜定休、チャージ300円、カード可、28席。口コミ (2026年、英語): 1956年からの老舗のバー、木屋町の南大黒橋通の入口の少し西、果物のカクテル (Amagatsu のジントニック、ラズベリーヨーグルト、ピンクグレープフルーツのソルティドッグ、エスプレッソマティーニ)、ノンアルコールのキウイのフローズンヨーグルト、生チョコ、丁寧なバーテンダー。

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Yakiniku with sauces, salt and wasabi; Korean cold noodles and bibimbap also on the menu; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku restaurant. Grilled vegetables are on the menu (official site).
kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:30 (last order 13:45); dinner 17:00–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); open every day (official site; Tabelog). Reservations taken, 2-hour seating limit; courses from 2 people, book the day before (Tabelog; official site). Cards and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog’s English note says 10%, but its Japanese original says none — ask. 34 seats: counter, tables, sofa seats and a tatami room by the window overlooking Shijo Kawaramachi; non-smoking; English menu (Tabelog; official site). Lunch rice refills free (official site; 2026 reviews). On the 8th floor of Kyoto Kawaramachi Garden, 1 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (official site).
kyoto_yakiniku_marutomi_shijo.notes: [Yakiniku · Shijo Kawaramachi, butcher-run, 8th-floor view] A yakiniku room high above the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing, run by a Kyoto butcher that has bought whole cattle since 1953 — Kumamoto akaushi and kuroge wagyu, cut by hand. Window tatami seats look over the city at night. Lunch sets from ¥1,300 with free rice refills; a "meat cake" for birthdays. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: The official site says Marutomi began as a butcher, founded in 1953, that buys whole carcasses of Saga, Miyazaki and Shikoku Saburo beef; the owner goes to select each animal, and the head chef trained at top hotels and bars. The restaurant opened in July 2017 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer adds that the butcher has one shop in Kyoto and one in Shiga.
chef_bio.philosophy: Whole-carcass buying lets high-grade meat be served for less; cuts are hand-sliced to suit each piece (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kumamoto akaushi and kuroge wagyu yakiniku; rare cuts such as hiuchi.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 regular surprised a friend with the meat cake for a coming-of-age celebration.
A June 2026 guest treated a parent to the Tamatebako course for a retirement celebration.
An April 2026 diner found the cuts good with salt and wasabi as well as the sauces, and liked the window seats over the night view.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 焼肉まる富、京都市下京区四条通河原町東入真町68 京都河原町ガーデン8F、阪急河原町駅から徒歩1分、祇園四条駅から徒歩3分、昼11:00〜14:30 (L.O.13:45)、夜17:00〜22:00 (フードL.O.21:00、ドリンクL.O.21:30)、年中無休。創業 (昭和28年) 以来一頭買いにこだわる精肉店から始まった焼肉店、佐賀牛・宮崎牛・四国三郎牛、オーナー自ら買い付け、手切り、一流ホテル・BARで修行を積んだ料理長、四条河原町を眺望できるお座敷席。メニュー: おすすめ盛り合わせ、厳選牛フィレステーキ、上ロース、上カルビ、上ハラミ、牛タン、褐毛和牛 熊本あか牛、ホルモン、トントロ、肉ケーキ、9種の肉玉手箱コース、ランチ (厳選牛焼肉定食1,300円ほか)。食べログ: 2017年7月12日オープン、34席、カード・PayPay可、禁煙、英語メニュー、2時間制、料金は2026年8月更新。口コミ (2026年、英語): 京都の老舗精肉店まる富の焼肉店、京都と滋賀に精肉店、特選和牛焼肉ランチ3,500円、ご飯おかわり可、夜景の見える窓際の席。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; cards accepted; reservations online.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog official listing (menu updated August 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_buonagio.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan-grilled steak and seafood, garlic rice, teppan curry, bread and desserts. The shop’s Tabelog profile ticks "gluten-free options" without detail (Tabelog).
kyoto_buonagio.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a steak and seafood teppanyaki house. The Tabelog profile ticks "vegetarian options" without detail — ask (Tabelog).
kyoto_buonagio.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–16:00 (last entry 14:30) Friday–Monday and holidays; dinner 17:30–23:00 (last entry 21:00) daily except Wednesday; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog; official site). Cards, PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted (Tabelog). A service charge is added (official site); 10% extra from 31 Dec to 3 Jan (Tabelog). 20 seats: 10 at the teppan counter, 5 tables for two; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English, Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog). Preschool children may be declined; under-10s seated at tables (official site). On the 2nd floor of GOOD NATURE STATION, next to Takashimaya, 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_buonagio.notes: [Teppanyaki · Shijo Kawaramachi, Kobe beef at a relaxed counter] A small teppan steak house, formerly on Dotonbori in Osaka, now on the 2nd floor of GOOD NATURE STATION by Takashimaya. Kobe beef and kuroge wagyu are grilled and flambéed across the counter, with live abalone and lobster. Lunch sets from about ¥4,000; rare wines by the glass. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a teppanyaki steak house that came from Dotonbori in Osaka, keeping its easy-going service, with the owner chatting across the teppan. Run by 株式会社ブォナージョ, registered in Sakai, Osaka (National Tax Agency invoice register T4120001210581).
chef_bio.philosophy: Teppanyaki "without the stiffness": no set pairings — each guest finds a match among rare wines kept fresh by a tasting machine (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kobe beef sirloin and filet steaks on the teppan.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular had the ¥3,980 lunch with a bottle of wine and praised the flambé and the chef’s pacing of each dish.
A July 2025 party walked in when the 1st-floor restaurant was full and found the owner very kind.
An April 2026 shopper sized the wagyu loin lunch up to 120g and ate it with just wasabi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: Steak House BUONAGIO (ブォナージョ)、京都・四条河原町の創作鉄板料理、神戸ビーフ、「Buono (美味しい)」と「Agio (寛ぐ)」、フランベ、道頓堀時代から変わらない気さくな接客、鉄板の向こうの店主と会話、希少なワインをテイスティングマシンでグラス提供、ペアリングはあえて行わない、別途サービス料、未就学児は入店を断る場合あり。メニュー: 神戸牛ステーキセット、黒毛和牛ステーキセット13,860円から、ランチ限定和牛ロースステーキセット3,980円から、活けアワビ、オマール海老、ガーリックシュリンプ、ガーリックライス、鉄板焼カレー、青じそピラフ、龍のたまごのプリン、フレンチトースト。食べログ: GOOD NATURE STATION 2F、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、ランチ金〜月・祝 11:30〜16:00、ディナー17:30〜23:00、水曜定休、20席、カード・QR可、禁煙、車椅子可、年末年始10%、インボイス T4120001210581 (株式会社ブォナージョ、大阪府堺市)。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 髙島屋の隣、カウンターで目の前で焼く、アワビ、スモークバター、デザート、静かで落ち着いた店内。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus; cards accepted.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog official listing (menu updated June 2026); reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kissa_giraffe.gf_detail: Ask. Napolitan spaghetti, omurice, thick toast and firm custard pudding; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_giraffe.vegan_detail: Not vegan: custard pudding with cream, omurice, butter toast (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_giraffe.hours_raw: 10:00–20:00 (last order 19:00, last entry 19:00); closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations. Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). One-drink minimum when ordering food (Tabelog; July 2026). Smoking allowed inside (several 2024–2026 reviews). Often full (2026 reviews). On the 2nd floor of the Main Building, northwest of the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing, about 90 m from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_kissa_giraffe.notes: [Kissaten · Shijo Kawaramachi, firm pudding and Napolitan] A retro coffee shop up a flight of stairs just off the Shijo Kawaramachi crossing, opened in 2020 and busy with young regulars. Come for the firm old-style pudding (¥600) and creamy Napolitan (¥900), or thick an-butter toast. Smoking allowed; cash only; one drink each with food. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a second-floor kissaten opened in 2020 with an old-fashioned look and a young crowd; smoking is allowed.
chef_bio.specialty: Firm custard pudding and Napolitan spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor sat at the counter while the owner chatted with regulars, who waved goodbye on leaving.
A September 2026 guest called it possibly the best retro pudding ever eaten.
An August 2026 first-timer was struck by the thickness of the toast at the next table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶 ジラフ、喫茶店、京都市中京区中之町583-10 メインビル2F、京都河原町駅から89m、10:00〜20:00 (L.O.19:00)、火曜定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、フード注文の場合ワンドリンク制、2020年9月27日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 四条河原町の北西、ビルの2階の隠れ家的な喫茶店、レトロな雰囲気、固めのプリン600円 (ホイップクリーム、カラメリゼ)、ナポリタン900円、オムライス950円、ミルクシェイク650円、あんバタートースト、ウインナーコーヒー650円、カフェオレ、ジンジャーエール (甘口・辛口)、喫煙可、若い客と常連が多い、満席になりがち。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; smoking allowed; one drink each.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Dashimaki omelette, simmered home-style dishes, tempura, kushikatsu and fried tofu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashimaki, nikujaga, dried fish, shishamo nanban-zuke (reviews). Pickled napa cabbage and okara are on the menu — ask (reviews).
kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 Thursday–Sunday; closed Monday–Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations taken; often full (Tabelog; November 2024). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). Counter, tables and tatami seating over two floors; walls (even the restroom) covered in guests’ graffiti (2024–2026 reviews). Drinks are simple: bottled beer, sake in small or large flasks, chuhai, lemon highball (2025 reviews). On Yanagikoji alley between Shinkyogoku and Kawaramachi, 3 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_izakaya_shizuka_yanagikoji.notes: [Izakaya · Yanagikoji, a Taisho-era tavern with graffiti walls] An izakaya on Yanagikoji alley said to date from the early Taisho era, behind a forbidding front; inside it feels like a film set, every wall scrawled with guests' messages. Come for the thick, dashi-rich dashimaki (about ¥500), nikujaga and simmered potatoes with a flask of sake — dinner for about ¥2,000. Cash only; Thursday–Sunday evenings.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a tavern founded in the early Taisho era, now with a new noren but an unchanged interior, its walls covered with graffiti left by guests; a November 2024 visitor found it run by the owner with the owner’s daughter and an older staff member.

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor had heard that the poet Nakahara Chuya and Hasegawa Yasuko drank here in the Taisho era, and came looking for traces among the graffiti.
A December 2025 solo drinker circled the entrance several times before going in, then was greeted with a cheerful "good evening".
A September 2026 party of five had the dashimaki cut into five portions.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋 静、居酒屋・おでん、京都市中京区新京極通四条上ル中之町577-17、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、木〜日 17:30〜22:00、月火水定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 柳小路の大正初期創業の居酒屋、新しいのれん、映画のセットのような昭和レトロの店内、壁一面の落書き (トイレにも)、カウンター・テーブル・座敷、2階もある、店主と娘さんと年配のスタッフ (2024年11月)、名物のだし巻510円、肉じゃが540円、白菜漬450円、小芋の煮物500円、おから430円、日本酒180ml 350円、丸干し、串カツ、天ぷら、厚揚げ、ししゃもの南蛮漬、瓶ビール、レモンハイ、会計2,000円ほど、詩人の中原中也と長谷川泰子が通ったと言われる (2025年6月の口コミ)。
